candidate_counterexample.claim: One already-accepted HOLD input event can currently be passed to apply_packet_turn_policy more than once. The function verifies in-memory admission and HOLD semantics but does not consume/fence the source event or reject an existing policy decision for the same source_event_id.
minimal_sequence: create one VoicePacketCortex and accept one non-final endpoint=HOLD input
apply PacketTurnPolicy(hold_intent=WAIT) to that exact accepted event
apply PacketTurnPolicy(hold_intent=BACKCHANNEL) again to the same exact accepted event
inspect cortex.events for two VOICE_INTENT events that both bind the same source_event_id but carry conflicting policy trajectories
candidate_counterexample.why_material: The WP720 boundary is a deterministic authoritative policy selection on the existing event fabric. Two conflicting policy decisions for one admitted source event would violate one-decision causal identity even though each individual call is locally valid and the PFD0-PFD5 matched-arm tests remain green.
candidate_counterexample.existing_test_gap: Current PFD0-PFD5 tests cover matched history, one changed policy dimension across separate arms, stable same-policy reruns across fresh cortex instances, metadata-only changes, foreign-event rejection, barge-in preservation and monotonic ordering, but not repeated policy application to the same accepted event in one cortex.

execution_status.local_review_execution_detail: Isolated review container could not resolve github.com, so no exact-repository executable product conclusion is claimed.

proposed_discriminator.required_result: Second application with a different policy must fail closed; an exact same-policy replay may either return the already-existing decision idempotently or fail closed consistently, but must not mint a second authoritative VOICE_INTENT.
proposed_discriminator.preferred_minimal_repair_if_reproduced: Use the already-persisted cortex event history as the replay/consumption fence: before emitting, locate any prior policy decision carrying the same source_event_id. Exact same policy hash may resolve idempotently to the existing event; a different policy hash/intent must raise PacketTurnPolicyError. Do not introduce a second persistent state authority or mutate WP715 recovery state merely to track this fence.
proposed_discriminator.recovery_property: An event-history-derived fence survives existing checkpoint/reentry because CortexEventPacket history is already serialized by the single WP715 recovery authority.

next_exact_action: WP720 mutation owner should add the PFD6 same-source-event replay/conflict regression to the existing repository discriminator. Only if executable evidence reproduces the counterexample should the owner repair the policy binding, then rerun PFD0-PFD6 plus existing VoicePacketCortex regressions before any VPS promotion.
